**Manuscript figure: Main Figure 6** · *See the README for the full list*

Tumor-informed **Wisp** output for a COLO829 titration series (0, 0.1, 1, 10 and 100% COLO829 DNA),
sequenced as ctDNA on Illumina and on Ultima. Both ctDNA datasets are analysed against the same
Illumina tumour/normal WGS of COLO829.

| Panel | Content |
|-------|---------|
| **A** | SNV tumour fraction per sample: Wisp-reported value, value before clonality correction, confidence interval and per-sample limit of detection (LoD) |
| **B** | What the SNV LoD is built from: tumour SNVs used, sequencing depth at tumour SNV sites in plasma, and the resulting SNV LoD |
| **C** | Tumour fraction per Wisp method (SNV, LOH, CNV) when detected |

Point the Configuration section at other runs — or your own oncoanalyser output — and knit;
see **Data access** below.

## Data access

Every input is public **oncoanalyser** output in the Google Cloud Storage bucket
`gs://hartwig-oapaper-celllines`. This figure reads only the Wisp summary file of each plasma
sample — 10 files of about 1.3 KB each, 13 KB in total:

```text
<run folder>/wisp/<tumour id>_<plasma id>.wisp.summary.tsv
```

One oncoanalyser run per platform, with one sub-folder per plasma sample:

```text
gs://hartwig-oapaper-celllines/COLO829/ctdna/<platform>/bwa/wisp/oa3/<plasma id>/
```

See `README.md` next to this file for how the data were generated, the tissue reference and
the sample-name mapping.

The plasma sample ids differ per platform (`10ng<x>p-tr` on Illumina, `Colomimic<x>` on Ultima).
Nothing is inferred from these names: the expected tumour fraction of every sample is set
explicitly in `SAMPLES` below.

There are three ways to supply the data:

1. **Read straight from the bucket** (the default). Needs the
   [Google Cloud SDK](https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/install) (`gsutil`). The 10 files are
   staged into `data/` next to this file and re-used afterwards.
2. **Copy the data down first**, e.g.
   `gcloud storage cp -r gs://hartwig-oapaper-celllines/COLO829/ctdna <local dir>`,
   then set `DATA_ROOT` to that local directory.
3. **Run it on your own Wisp output.** Point `run_folder()` / `SAMPLES` at any oncoanalyser 3.x
   run folders that contain `wisp/*.wisp.summary.tsv`.

Figures (and the knitted HTML, when using the RStudio *Knit* button) are written to `figures/`
next to this file. `data/` and `figures/` are git-ignored.

**R packages:** `rmarkdown`, `knitr`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `readr`, `stringr`, `ggplot2`, `patchwork`.

## 1 · Configuration

```{r config}
# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION — edit these to point at your own oncoanalyser output.
# ============================================================================
DATA_ROOT <- "gs://hartwig-oapaper-celllines"   # or a local directory (absolute, or ~ is fine)

# One folder per plasma sample: <DATA_ROOT>/COLO829/ctdna/<platform>/bwa/wisp/oa3/<plasma id>
run_folder <- function(platform, plasma_id) {
  file.path(sub("/+$", "", DATA_ROOT), "COLO829", "ctdna", platform, "bwa", "wisp", "oa3", plasma_id)
}

# Every plasma sample in the figure, with its expected (spiked-in) COLO829 tumour fraction.
# `setup` is the label used in the figure legend.
SAMPLES <- tibble::tribble(
  ~setup,           ~platform,               ~plasma_id,     ~expected_pct,
  "Illumina ctDNA", "illumina_novaseq6000",  "10ng0p-tr",    0,
  "Illumina ctDNA", "illumina_novaseq6000",  "10ng01p-tr",   0.1,
  "Illumina ctDNA", "illumina_novaseq6000",  "10ng1p-tr",    1,
  "Illumina ctDNA", "illumina_novaseq6000",  "10ng10p-tr",   10,
  "Illumina ctDNA", "illumina_novaseq6000",  "10ng100p-tr",  100,
  "Ultima ctDNA",   "ultima_ug100",          "Colomimic0",   0,
  "Ultima ctDNA",   "ultima_ug100",          "Colomimic01",  0.1,
  "Ultima ctDNA",   "ultima_ug100",          "Colomimic1",   1,
  "Ultima ctDNA",   "ultima_ug100",          "Colomimic10",  10,
  "Ultima ctDNA",   "ultima_ug100",          "Colomimic100", 100
)

SETUP_COLOURS <- c("Illumina ctDNA" = "#FF6B00", "Ultima ctDNA" = "#343434")

# Output: half an A4 page lengthwise, full A4 width; all text at least FONT_SIZE_PT
FIG_WIDTH_MM  <- 210
FIG_HEIGHT_MM <- 297 / 2
FONT_SIZE_PT  <- 9
PNG_DPI       <- 600
SAVE_PDF      <- FALSE   # vector PDF in addition to the PNG

DATA_DIR   <- "data"      # local cache for staged inputs (relative to this file)
FIGURE_DIR <- "figures"   # output directory (relative to this file)
```

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
options(scipen = 999)
```

## 2 · Locating and staging Wisp output

Finds the Wisp summary file in every configured run folder and copies it into `DATA_DIR`
(remote) or reads it in place (local). A missing file stops the analysis with the path it
looked for, rather than silently dropping a sample.

```{r locate}
is_remote <- function(p) startsWith(p, "gs://")

# Finds the gsutil executable.
# Checks the PATH first, then the usual Google Cloud SDK install locations.
find_gsutil <- function() {
  on_path <- Sys.which("gsutil")
  if (nzchar(on_path)) return(unname(on_path))
  candidates <- c(
    "~/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gsutil",                                        # default installer
    "/opt/homebrew/bin/gsutil", "/usr/local/bin/gsutil",                    # Homebrew
    "/opt/homebrew/share/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gsutil",
    "/usr/local/share/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gsutil",
    "/usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gsutil", "/snap/bin/gsutil"              # Linux packages
  )
  hit <- candidates[file.exists(path.expand(candidates))]
  if (length(hit) > 0) return(path.expand(hit[1]))
  stop("gsutil was not found. Install the Google Cloud SDK ",
       "(https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/install), or add its bin/ folder to PATH, e.g. in ",
       "~/.Renviron: PATH=${PATH}:${HOME}/google-cloud-sdk/bin. Alternatively, copy the data ",
       "locally and set DATA_ROOT to that folder.", call. = FALSE)
}
GSUTIL <- NULL   # resolved on first use, so local-only runs never need gsutil

# Runs gsutil and returns its stdout lines. stderr is kept separate, so progress and
# update notices never end up in a file listing. Returns NULL when the target does not
# exist; stops on any other failure (authentication, permissions, typo'd bucket).
gsutil <- function(...) {
  if (is.null(GSUTIL)) GSUTIL <<- find_gsutil()
  err_file <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(err_file))
  out <- suppressWarnings(system2(GSUTIL, c(...), stdout = TRUE, stderr = err_file))
  err <- readLines(err_file, warn = FALSE)
  status <- attr(out, "status")
  if (!is.null(status) && status != 0) {
    if (any(grepl("matched no objects|No URLs matched|404", err, ignore.case = TRUE))) return(NULL)
    stop("gsutil ", paste(c(...), collapse = " "), " failed:\n", paste(err, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  out
}

# Returns the local path of the one *.wisp.summary.tsv in <run>/wisp/
locate_summary <- function(run, platform, plasma_id) {
  if (is_remote(run)) {
    hits <- gsutil("ls", paste0(run, "/wisp/*.wisp.summary.tsv"))
  } else {
    hits <- Sys.glob(file.path(path.expand(run), "wisp", "*.wisp.summary.tsv"))
  }
  hits <- hits[nzchar(hits)]
  if (length(hits) != 1) {
    stop(sprintf("Expected exactly one *.wisp.summary.tsv in %s/wisp/, found %d.",
                 run, length(hits)), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is_remote(run)) return(hits)

  dest <- file.path(DATA_DIR, platform, plasma_id, basename(hits))
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    dir.create(dirname(dest), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    gsutil("cp", hits, dest)
  }
  dest
}

SAMPLES <- SAMPLES %>%
  mutate(run          = mapply(run_folder, platform, plasma_id),
         summary_file = mapply(locate_summary, run, platform, plasma_id))

SAMPLES %>% select(setup, plasma_id, expected_pct, run) %>% kable()
```

## 3 · Loading

```{r load}
read_summary <- function(f) {
  read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE,
           col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
}

num_cols <- c("SNVPurity", "RawSNVPurity", "SNVPurityLow", "SNVPurityHigh", "SNVLod",
              "CalcVariants", "TotalVariants", "WeightedAvgDepth", "BqrThreshold",
              "LOHPurity", "CopyNumberPurity")

wisp <- SAMPLES %>%
  mutate(data = lapply(summary_file, read_summary)) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), as.numeric),
         across(c(SNV_MRD, LOH_MRD, CNV_MRD), ~ toupper(.x) == "TRUE"),
         setup = factor(setup, levels = names(SETUP_COLOURS)))

# Sanity check: SNVLod is a fraction (not %), and equals the lod= value Wisp lists in
# BqrExtraInfo for the base-quality threshold it selected (the one with the lowest LoD).
bqr_lod <- mapply(function(info, thr) {
  as.numeric(str_match(info, paste0("BqrThreshold\\(", thr, " [^)]*lod=([0-9.eE+-]+)"))[, 2])
}, wisp$BqrExtraInfo, wisp$BqrThreshold)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(bqr_lod), wisp$SNVLod)))

wisp %>%
  arrange(expected_pct, setup) %>%
  transmute(setup, plasma_id, `expected %` = expected_pct, SNV_MRD,
            `reported TF %`  = signif(SNVPurity * 100, 3),
            `TF before clonality correction %` = signif(RawSNVPurity * 100, 3),
            `CI %`           = paste0(signif(SNVPurityLow * 100, 3), "–", signif(SNVPurityHigh * 100, 3)),
            `SNV LoD %`      = signif(SNVLod * 100, 3),
            `SNVs used`      = CalcVariants,
            `depth at SNV sites` = WeightedAvgDepth,
            BqrThreshold, ClonalMethod) %>%
  kable()
```

Column notes (Wisp 1.3.1):

- `SNVPurity` is the reported tumour fraction; 0 when ctDNA is not detected (`SNV_MRD = FALSE`,
  one-sided Poisson p ≥ 0.01 against the background error rate).
- `RawSNVPurity` is the estimate before the clonality correction (`ClonalMethod`).
- `SNVPurityLow`/`SNVPurityHigh` come from the 1% and 99% Poisson quantiles of the
  tumour-allele fragment count, i.e. a 98% interval.
- `SNVLod` is the tumour fraction at which detection would reach p = 0.01. Wisp evaluates
  base-quality thresholds 0, 38, 42 and 45 and keeps the one with the lowest LoD
  (`BqrThreshold`); this also changes `CalcVariants`.

## 4 · Plotting style

```{r style}
nd_floor   <- 1e-3    # y-position (%) used to draw 'reported 0 / not detected'
x_zero_pos <- 0.003   # x-position (%) used to draw the 0% sample on a log axis
dodge      <- setNames(10^c(-0.07, 0.07), names(SETUP_COLOURS))

levels_pct <- sort(unique(wisp$expected_pct))
x_breaks   <- ifelse(levels_pct == 0, x_zero_pos, levels_pct)
x_labels   <- format(levels_pct, drop0trailing = TRUE, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
min_pos    <- min(levels_pct[levels_pct > 0])
x_title    <- "COLO829 expected tumor fraction [%]"

pct_label <- function(p) factor(format(p, drop0trailing = TRUE, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
                                 levels = x_labels)
plain_num <- function(b) format(b, scientific = FALSE, drop0trailing = TRUE, trim = TRUE, big.mark = ",")

theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## 5 · Panel A — SNV tumour fraction, confidence interval and LoD

```{r panel-a, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
plot_df <- wisp %>%
  mutate(x       = ifelse(expected_pct == 0, x_zero_pos, expected_pct) * dodge[as.character(setup)],
         rep_pct = SNVPurity * 100,
         raw_pct = RawSNVPurity * 100,
         lod_pct = SNVLod * 100,
         lo_pct  = SNVPurityLow * 100,
         hi_pct  = SNVPurityHigh * 100,
         rep_y   = ifelse(rep_pct > 0, rep_pct, nd_floor),
         raw_y   = ifelse(raw_pct > 0, raw_pct, nd_floor))

p_a <- ggplot(plot_df) +
  # 'not detected' band (Wisp reports 0)
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = nd_floor / 1.6, ymax = nd_floor * 1.6,
           fill = "grey93") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = nd_floor, label = "Wisp reports 0 (not detected)",
           hjust = 1, size = FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt, colour = "grey40") +
  # expected identity line + expected 0
  annotate("segment", x = min_pos, xend = 100, y = min_pos, yend = 100,
           linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  annotate("point", x = x_zero_pos, y = nd_floor, shape = 4, colour = "grey55", size = 1.8) +
  # per-sample LoD (horizontal dash)
  geom_segment(aes(x = x / 1.12, xend = x * 1.12, y = lod_pct, yend = lod_pct,
                   colour = setup, linetype = "SNV LOD"), linewidth = 0.6) +
  # confidence interval
  geom_linerange(aes(x = x, ymin = pmax(lo_pct, nd_floor), ymax = pmax(hi_pct, nd_floor),
                     colour = setup), linewidth = 0.4,
                 data = ~ filter(.x, hi_pct > 0)) +
  # estimate before clonality correction (open) and Wisp-reported estimate (filled)
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = raw_y, colour = setup, shape = "Before clonality correction"),
             size = 2, stroke = 0.6, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = rep_y, fill = setup, shape = "Wisp reported"),
             size = 1.3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.25) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels, limits = c(0.0022, 160)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(nd_floor, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100),
                labels = c("0", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "100"),
                limits = c(nd_floor / 1.6, 160)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = SETUP_COLOURS, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SETUP_COLOURS,
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 2), order = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Wisp reported" = 21, "Before clonality correction" = 21),
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
                       fill = c("white", "grey30"), colour = c("grey30", "white"),
                       size = c(2, 1.3)), order = 2)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("SNV LOD" = "solid"),
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey30"), order = 3)) +
  labs(x = x_title, y = "Wisp SNV tumor fraction [%]") +
  theme_fig
p_a
```

## 6 · Panel B — what the SNV LoD is built from

| Sub-panel | Wisp column |
|---|---|
| Tumor SNVs used | `CalcVariants` |
| Sequencing depth at tumor SNV sites in plasma | `WeightedAvgDepth` |
| SNV LOD [%] | `SNVLod` × 100 (Wisp stores a fraction) |

```{r panel-b, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
lod_vars <- c("Tumor SNVs used", "Sequencing depth at tumor SNV sites in plasma", "SNV LOD [%]")

lod_long <- wisp %>%
  transmute(setup, x_lab = pct_label(expected_pct),
            `Tumor SNVs used` = CalcVariants,
            `Sequencing depth at tumor SNV sites in plasma` = WeightedAvgDepth,
            `SNV LOD [%]` = SNVLod * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(setup, x_lab)) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = lod_vars))

p_b <- ggplot(lod_long, aes(x = x_lab, y = value, colour = setup, group = setup)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = setup), shape = 21, colour = "white", size = 1.8, stroke = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = plain_num, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = SETUP_COLOURS, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SETUP_COLOURS) +
  labs(x = x_title, y = NULL) +
  theme_fig +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0))
p_b

wisp %>% group_by(setup) %>%
  summarise(`mean SNV LoD %` = signif(mean(SNVLod) * 100, 2)) %>% kable()
```

## 7 · Panel C — tumour fraction per Wisp method

Wisp estimates the tumour fraction from tumour SNVs, from allelic imbalance in tumour LOH
regions, and from the tumour copy-number profile. Each has its own detection call
(`SNV_MRD`, `LOH_MRD`, `CNV_MRD`). Tiles show the estimate when detected; ND = not detected.

```{r panel-c, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.8}
c_df <- wisp %>%
  select(setup, expected_pct, SNV_MRD, SNVPurity, LOH_MRD, LOHPurity, CNV_MRD, CopyNumberPurity) %>%
  rename(SNV_TF = SNVPurity, LOH_TF = LOHPurity, CNV_TF = CopyNumberPurity) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(setup, expected_pct), names_to = c("modality", ".value"), names_sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(modality = factor(modality, levels = c("CNV", "LOH", "SNV")),
         x_lab    = pct_label(expected_pct),
         lab      = ifelse(MRD, paste0(signif(TF * 100, 2), "%"), "ND")) %>%
  complete(setup, x_lab, modality, fill = list(lab = "not sequenced", MRD = NA)) %>%
  mutate(tile = case_when(is.na(MRD) ~ "Not sequenced",
                          MRD        ~ as.character(setup),
                          TRUE       ~ "Not detected"))

p_c <- ggplot(c_df, aes(x = x_lab, y = modality)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = tile), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = tile), size = FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt) +
  facet_wrap(~ setup, ncol = 1, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(SETUP_COLOURS, "Not detected" = "grey90", "Not sequenced" = "white")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(setNames(rep("white", length(SETUP_COLOURS)), names(SETUP_COLOURS)),
                                 "Not detected" = "grey40", "Not sequenced" = "grey65"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = x_title, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))
p_c
```

## 8 · Combined figure

```{r combined, fig.width=210/25.4, fig.height=297/2/25.4, dpi=200}
# one shared legend: keep panel A's, drop the duplicate ones from B and C
fig <- (p_a | (p_b + guides(fill = "none"))) / (p_c + guides(fill = "none")) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.9, 1), widths = c(1.1, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(text        = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
        axis.text   = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
        axis.title  = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
        legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = FONT_SIZE_PT + 2))
fig

dir.create(FIGURE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "fig_longitudinal")
ggsave(paste0(out, ".png"), fig, width = FIG_WIDTH_MM, height = FIG_HEIGHT_MM,
       units = "mm", dpi = PNG_DPI, bg = "white")
if (SAVE_PDF) {
  # standard pdf device (cairo_pdf needs XQuartz on macOS)
  ggsave(paste0(out, ".pdf"), fig, width = FIG_WIDTH_MM, height = FIG_HEIGHT_MM,
         units = "mm", device = "pdf", useDingbats = FALSE)
}
```
